articles.title: Hyundai India Launches Usage-Based Insurance (Nov 2026)
articles.excerpt: Hyundai Motor India announced on 5 November 2026 a usage-based insurance scheme for Bluelink cars. A driving score of 70 or more may unlock up to 15% off the own-damage premium.
blocks: Hyundai Motor India Limited (HMIL) announced a **usage-based insurance (UBI)** programme on 5 November 2026 for owners of Bluelink-connected cars. Under it, a driving score built from the previous three months of driving may help eligible customers get insurance benefits at renewal. HMIL's managing director and CEO, Tarun Garg, said that in certain cases customers may save up to 15 per cent on the own-damage part of the premium, depending on each insurer's underwriting rules.

Bluelink is Hyundai's connected-car system. According to the reports on the announcement, the car's own data is used, so owners do not need to fit an extra device. The score is shown in the Bluelink app, and the owner chooses whether to share it with an insurer.

The score covers driving over the previous three months
It looks at rapid acceleration, rapid deceleration, rapid braking, speed control and idling
Customers whose insurance renewal is due within the next 90 days can see their score and check their eligibility
A score of 70 or above may unlock benefits, subject to the insurer's underwriting policy and terms
Customers below 70 get personalised driving tips

Hyundai India Insurance Broking (HIIB) acts as the go-between for Hyundai and the insurers. It passes on driving scores only with the customer's consent. The first phase includes three insurers: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance, Go Digit General Insurance and ICICI Lombard. The programme is available across Hyundai's Bluelink-connected models, for eligible customers.

The figure applies to the **own-damage** component, the part of a motor policy that covers damage to the car itself. It is not a cut in the whole premium, which also includes third-party cover. Business Today quotes Mr Garg saying the saving applies "in certain cases", based on insurers' rules. Rushlane notes that Hyundai has not published a detailed table linking scores to discounts.
What this means for Hyundai owners

The programme only applies if the car is connected through Bluelink and the owner agrees to share the score. Owners who do nothing are not affected, and sharing is a choice made in the app. Insurers remain free to decide how much weight a score carries, because the release says benefits depend on each insurer's underwriting policy and terms.

Usage-based insurance is not new in the world: insurers in several countries have priced policies on telematics data for years. In India, the idea of linking premiums to how a car is used has been discussed for some time, and this is a manufacturer-led version that uses data the car already collects. The sources checked for this article do not describe any regulator statement on the Hyundai scheme, so none is reported here.

The announcement was made on Thursday, 5 November 2026. Business Today and Rushlane both date their reports the same day, and Autocar India's report is dated 5 November as well. Since the 90-day window depends on each customer's own renewal date, the scheme will reach different owners at different times, and nothing in the sources gives a start date for any one policy.

How much of a discount each score band earns, beyond the 70 threshold and the up-to-15% ceiling
Whether a low score could raise a renewal quote: the Rushlane report says the release does not specify this
Which Hyundai models and model years count as Bluelink-connected for this scheme, beyond the company's statement that it covers its connected portfolio
Mr Garg also said the company already has more than eight lakh connected cars on Indian roads, according to Rushlane's account of the announcement.
This is general information about a company announcement as of 6 November 2026. Policy terms are set by each insurer, so a policy document is the place to check what applies to a particular car.

sources.title: Drive safe, save big: Hyundai's connected car customers can now opt for usage-based insurance, Business Today
Hyundai introduces usage-based insurance benefits for Bluelink customers, Autocar India

articles.title: Ducati Desmo450 EDX and MX Factory Launched in India
articles.excerpt: Ducati launched the Desmo450 EDX at Rs 18.55 lakh and the Desmo450 MX Factory at Rs 21.26 lakh (ex-showroom) in India on 5 November 2026. Bookings are open.
blocks: Ducati has launched two off-road motorcycles in India: the **Desmo450 EDX** at **Rs 18.55 lakh** and the **Desmo450 MX Factory** at **Rs 21.26 lakh**, both ex-showroom. Autocar India reported the launch on 5 November 2026. Bookings are open at Ducati dealerships across the country. The EDX is built for enduro and cross-country riding, and the MX Factory is built for motocross racing. Both are off-road machines, and the reports describe them as competition-focused models.

Ducati Desmo450 EDX: Rs 18.55 lakh (ex-showroom)
Ducati Desmo450 MX Factory: Rs 21.26 lakh (ex-showroom)
Ducati Desmo450 MX (2026 model, already on sale): Rs 17.24 lakh, unchanged, per Autocar India
Autocar India adds that the standard 2027 Desmo450 MX has not been launched in India yet. Those prices are for India only and do not include on-road costs.

Both bikes use a 449.6 cc, liquid-cooled, single-cylinder engine with Ducati's Desmodromic valve system, in which the valves are closed by a mechanism instead of springs. Motoroids lists 63.5 hp at 9,400 rpm and 53.5 Nm at 7,500 rpm, with about 70 per cent of peak torque available from 4,200 rpm. The electronics include traction control, launch control, engine-brake control, a two-way quickshifter and power and riding modes, according to Autocar India.

8.5-litre fuel tank (7.2 litres on the MX)
21-inch front and 18-inch rear wheels with Pirelli Scorpion XC Mid-Soft tyres
Weight of 107.1 kg without fuel
Handguards, an engine skid plate and a side stand as standard
One colour: Ducati Red
Showa suspension with 310 mm of fork travel and 301 mm at the rear, set up for enduro riding
Desmo450 MX Factory: made for the track

Weight of 104 kg without fuel
7.2-litre fuel tank and Ducati Corse livery
Full Akrapovic exhaust with its own engine mapping
Holeshot device to help manage race starts
51-tooth rear sprocket (up from 49) for more rear-wheel torque out of corners
RK MXU O-ring chain, sump guard and a disc rotor guard
21-inch front and 19-inch rear wheels with Pirelli Scorpion MX32 Mid-Soft tyres
Brembo callipers with Galfer discs, 260 mm front and 240 mm rear
The reports say Showa suspension on the 2027 bikes has a Dark Kashima coating and a titanium oxide treatment for wear resistance.
What the difference between the two means

Motocross is racing on short closed tracks with jumps and berms. Enduro and cross-country riding cover longer routes over mixed ground, so the EDX has a bigger tank, a skid plate, handguards and a side stand, items a long ride needs and a short race does not. The MX Factory drops those items and adds race-focused parts such as the titanium exhaust and a holeshot device, which helps the rider get a controlled start from the gate.
Both weights are quoted without fuel, so a full tank adds to them. The 8.5-litre tank on the EDX holds about 1.3 litres more than the 7.2-litre tank on the MX models.

The reports say bookings are open across Ducati dealerships in India, without naming a deposit amount or a delivery date. Motoroids says the MX Factory and EDX use the same engine and electronics package, so the main differences are in the chassis set-up, tyres, tank and the equipment listed above. As with all prices in this article, the figures are ex-showroom as given by the outlets, and local taxes, registration and insurance are extra.

Ducati entered India's motocross segment earlier in 2026 with the Desmo450 MX. The company has not published figures for expected sales in India. The sources checked do not give delivery dates for the new models, so buyers would need to ask a dealer.
Prices are ex-showroom as reported on 5 November 2026 by Autocar India and Motoroids. Ducati's own India page was not available to check.

articles.title: Volkswagen Virtus Facelift Exterior Revealed (Nov 2026)
articles.excerpt: Volkswagen India released official exterior images of the Virtus facelift on 5 and 6 November 2026. Interior, features, price and launch date have not been announced.
blocks: Volkswagen India has released official exterior images of the **Virtus facelift**, the first major update to the midsize sedan since it launched in India in June 2022. The first teaser appeared on 5 November 2026 and clearer images followed. Volkswagen has not yet announced the interior, features, engines, price or launch date. This article is written as of 6 November 2026.
According to Autocar India and Rushlane, the images show a GT version in blue with changes around the bumpers, grille, wheels and rear lights.

New front bumper with a wide lower grille using diamond-shaped openings
A slimmer upper grille and a red GT badge
Headlights with separate LED daytime running lights and no connected strip across the nose
Revised tail-lights
Black alloy wheels with a new angular spoke pattern, black mirror housings and red brake callipers
Cameras at the front and rear and under the mirror, which Rushlane says suggests a 360-degree surround-view system

Autocar India separately lists front parking sensors and a 360-degree camera set-up among the changes it reports. Reports differ on small details: the first teaser was dark, and outlets disagreed on whether it showed an illuminated badge and fog lamps. Volkswagen has not detailed the lighting equipment.
Why a facelift matters to buyers

A facelift, also called a mid-life update, changes a car's styling and equipment without building a new model. The Virtus has been on sale in India since 2022, so this is the first time Volkswagen has refreshed its look. Because the underlying car is expected to stay the same, owners of the current model should not assume that every change will carry over, since Volkswagen has not said which updates apply to which variants.

The images show a GT version, which is the sportier trim with black wheels and red accents. Volkswagen has not said how the other trims will look, so the dual-tone wheels mentioned by Autocar India for other trims remain an expectation.

Volkswagen introduced the Virtus in India in June 2022 as a midsize sedan built on its India-focused platform. Autocar India calls this its first comprehensive update, and its report says the facelift follows the one given to the Taigun, the Virtus's SUV sibling. That comparison is the outlet's, and Volkswagen has not said which features the two cars will share.

The company has not published a date for a full reveal of the cabin. Until it does, the details above should be read as what the images show, and nothing more. The article will not be updated by this site once published, so the date at the top matters: it describes the position on 6 November 2026.

Both outlets say the interior and feature list have not been revealed. Autocar India writes that updates are expected to resemble those on the Volkswagen Taigun facelift, and names a larger 10.25-inch digital instrument cluster and a refreshed 10.1-inch infotainment system as possibilities. It also says an 8-speed torque-converter automatic could replace the 6-speed automatic that is paired with the 1.0-litre turbo-petrol engine. These are expectations from the press, not Volkswagen statements.

Interior design and feature list
Engine and gearbox options
Price (Autocar India shows an expected price of Rs 10.75 lakh, which is its own estimate)
Official launch date: several outlets point to December 2026, but Volkswagen has not confirmed it
Whether the model name will change
The Virtus is Volkswagen's midsize sedan in India. Autocar India's page shows the current Virtus at Rs 10.80 lakh to Rs 19.70 lakh. Those are the current prices, not those of the facelift.
The exterior is official. Everything about the interior, engines, price and date is unconfirmed as of 6 November 2026, so treat it as expectation.

sources.title: Volkswagen Virtus facelift exterior revealed in full, Autocar India
Volkswagen Virtus facelift teased, Autocar India
